correctness.rationale: Each truncation vertex is a signed/permuted (1,a,a), a=1−2t. Supports give ||D_t||∞≤2 and all diagonal halfspaces sum|x_i|≤2+2a. The 24 signed permutations of (2,2a,0) are exactly the vertex set of their intersection for 0<a<1 and each occurs as a pairwise difference of actual truncated tetrahedron vertices; merged endpoint vertices treated separately. A diagonal hexagonal facet is centrally symmetric only when opposite-pair sums coincide, i.e. a=1/2, and the six explicit segment generators yield that zonotope. Endpoints contain triangular faces, so not zonotopes. The closest facet distance to 0 gives min width, with equality facet normals only axis or diagonal; transition algebra gives t0. Independent exact rational vertex/containment checks for t=0,1/8,1/4,3/8,1/2 verified vertex sets and inclusions, not a substitute for all-real proof.
